answer: The cheapest real defence: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because hollow only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, haven is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any ripple approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
